Its native cooldown became available during GUID 106's exposure, but the global Feral healer-exposure cadence block submitted Stampeding Roar first and returned. That global-cooldown action preempted the exact one-hostile Growl pickup, and the remote healer-cluster handoff consumed the first post-GCD decision before Growl finally landed. The healer therefore retained GUID 106 for 3576 ms.

generation_14_exposure_evidence.cause: The rerun144 post-Roar area-retention resolver requires a local follower to both still target the healer and carry the Feral's Demoralizing Roar aura. A successful Roar transfers affected local followers to the tank, while the followers that remain on the healer are the uncovered set. The conjunction therefore rejects the exact successful local coverage it was intended to prove. The damaging area-retention branch never ran, and the Feral spent repeated decisions holding for another Roar while already acquisition-eligible followers remained on the healer.
